title: Speechius
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score

zh.gap: 市面上的提词器要么定速滚动，要么要一只手按遥控。真正跟住一个活人说话，要的是带口音的实时语音对齐——今年才便宜到可以白送。
zh.pain: 自己拍口播的人——录课的老师、自己拍产品视频的小店主——时间主要不是花在讲错，而是提词器按秒往下滚：你一停下想词，字就跑没了，整条重录。
zh.kill: 这是一个功能不是一家公司：BIGVU、PromptSmart 已经有语音跟随，手机厂商或剪辑软件补上也就一个版本的事。
zh.move: 别卖提词器，卖「这条能不能用」：一停止录制就标出你念漏的句子和吃字的那几秒，并给一句留不留的判断。冷启动：中文=小红书「口播 提词器」「录课 卡壳」标签；英文=r/NewTubers 的 I re-record every take 帖。

gap: Every teleprompter on the market either scrolls at a fixed rate or needs a hand on a remote. Following a real speaker in real time needs accented streaming speech alignment, which only became cheap enough to give away this year.
pain: People who film their own talking-head video — a teacher recording a lesson, a shop owner recording a product clip — lose most of their time not to fluffing a line but to the teleprompter scrolling on a timer: you pause to find the word, the text runs away, and you re-shoot the whole take.
kill: This is a feature, not a company — BIGVU and PromptSmart already have voice tracking, and a phone maker or an editing suite absorbs it in one release.
move: Stop selling the prompter and sell 'is this take usable': the moment you stop recording, mark the sentences you dropped and the seconds you swallowed words, and say whether to keep it. Cold start (Chinese): 小红书 「口播 提词器」「录课 卡壳」 tags; (English): the 'I re-record every take' threads in r/NewTubers.
